newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower in brisk trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower in brisk trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly lower on Thursday as leading issues continued sliding in lively trade.
* Of 15 active issues eight were down, four up and three flat.
* Volume up at 13,369 units, turnover doubled to 15.7 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer brewery Karlovacka Pivovara added 10 kuna or 3.3 percent to 310 on volume of 100 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Jadroplov lost 65 kuna or 34 percent to 125 on volume of 100 shares.
* Most actively traded issue Zagrebacka Banka lost 40 kuna or two percent to 1,960 on volume of 6,123. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
